requirements.name: One record is kept per notification, updated in place as it changes

scenarios.name: An in-progress notification is tracked as Draft, with its detail

tests.test: creates and updates aggregated notification document through the submission lifecycle
tests.notes: first half: polls Mongo for one DRAFT doc with referenceNumber, originCountry and arrivalDate after journey.toDeclaration()
proves upsert writes DRAFT status and snapshot fields under a version guard; does not run the live-animals journey

scenarios.name: Submitting the notification updates the same record to Submitted

tests.test: creates and updates aggregated notification document through the submission lifecycle
tests.notes: second half: after submit, same _id is SUBMITTED, countDocuments(_id)=1, aggregateVersion advanced
version-guarded upsert is the mechanism that updates in place rather than inserting a second record
stale lower versions match nothing via $lt — supports in-place update without duplicates
